theme_archetype.vibe: Premium, modern, hyper-organized, and sharply contrasted. Mixes the clinical precision of scheduling tools with the artistic, moody edge of a high-end tattoo studio.

fonts.monospace: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Monaco, Consolas, monospace

scale_rules.Labels: text-xs uppercase tracking-[0.15em] font-inter font-medium text-zinc-500

interactive.secondary_button: bg-white text-zinc-900 border border-zinc-200 hover:bg-zinc-50 transition-colors shadow-soft

layout_and_spacing.grid_system: Mode B: 'The Control Room' Grid - gap-4 or gap-6. Dashboard uses strict geometric alignment.
layout_and_spacing.spacing: Generous spacing. Cards must have p-6 or p-8 padding. Sections separated by gap-8 or gap-12.
layout_and_spacing.borderRadius: Rounded corners (rounded-2xl) paired with crisp 1px borders to ground them. Buttons use rounded-xl.

cards.booking_card: Minimalist card layout. White bg, border-zinc-200, shadow-sm hover:shadow-card-hover transition-all duration-300 ease-apple. Use a structured layout: Left column for timestamp and status (Inter), Right column for Artist info (Playfair). Actions pinned to bottom.
cards.studio_card: Highlight immediate next appointments with an inverted theme (bg-zinc-900 text-white border-none shadow-card) to create high visual contrast in the overview tab.

navigation.tabs: Clean underline tabs or minimalist pills. Active state: text-zinc-900 border-b-2 border-zinc-900. Inactive: text-zinc-500 hover:text-zinc-700.
navigation.header: Sticky glassmorphism header (backdrop-blur-xl bg-white/70) with a 1px border-b border-zinc-200.

badges.style: Pill shape (rounded-full), px-3 py-1 text-xs font-medium border. Eg: 'Pending' is bg-amber-50 text-amber-700 border-amber-200.

video_button.style: Include a subtle pulsing red dot next to it for live status, and utilize font-mono for the countdown timer to simulate precision.

empty_states.style: High negative space (py-24, flex col center). Use a 1.5px stroke Lucide icon (e.g., CalendarX or Moon) in text-zinc-300 and a Playfair heading like 'Rest & Recover' or 'Keine Buchungen'.

motion_and_interactions.hover: Cards lift slightly (-translate-y-1) with shadow-card-hover. Buttons use active:scale-95.
motion_and_interactions.transitions: Use 'transition-all duration-300 ease-apple' for structural changes and 'duration-200' for color shifts.
motion_and_interactions.loading: Use skeleton loaders with 'animate-shimmer' or 'animate-pulse' in bg-zinc-200/50.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure all text meets APCA guidelines. Use zinc-900 for primary elements.
accessibility.test_ids: Every interactive element MUST have data-testid='...' (e.g. data-testid='cancel-booking-btn', data-testid='video-join-btn').

image_urls.description: Premium modern tattoo studio interior for studio profile backgrounds.
Tattoo artist portrait for avatar placeholders.

instructions_to_main_agent: Redesign the Customer Dashboard using a clean tabbed layout (Heute, Kommend, Vergangen). Use the structured Booking Card layout.
Redesign the Studio Dashboard. Implement the Header, Übersicht, Buchungen, Kalender, Artists, Profil, and Einstellungen tabs.
For the Studio Übersicht tab, highlight the 'Today's immediate appointment' with a dark inverted card (bg-zinc-900, text-white) for sharp contrast.
Strictly apply Playfair Display (font-serif) for all Headings (H1-H3, Card Titles) and Inter (font-inter) for body text and data points.
Ensure the video consultation button incorporates a font-mono countdown timer and live polling logic.
Utilize lucide-react icons with strokeWidth={1.5} for a sharp, premium tech feel.
Integrate Shadcn primitives heavily customized with Tailwind classes matching these guidelines.
Include 'data-testid' on all interactive elements to support robust testing.
